answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted reputation with slow decay: every agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can vouch for others, and the weight of its attestations grows only with a long history of accurate judgments, like a knoll that rises one grain at a time. A sybil operator can spin up many fresh identities, but each one starts at zero weight, and building a convincing history costs real time and locked funds. When a gale of fake accounts floods in, the network ignores low-weight voices, the way a river ignores pebbles, letting only proven participants steer shared decisions.
